paragraphs.text: 1. DRINK Soma juice for mighty power and vigour, drink, Strongest One, that thou mayst smite down Vrtra.
paragraphs.original: पिबा सोमं महत इन्द्रियाय पिबा वृत्राय हन्तवे शविष्ठ ।
paragraphs.translit: pibā somaṃ mahata indriyāya pibā vṛtrāya hantave śaviṣṭha |

paragraphs.text: Drink thou, invoked, for strength, and riches: drink thou thy fill of meath and pour it down, O Indra.
paragraphs.original: पिब राये शवसे हूयमानः पिब मध्वस्तृपदिन्द्रा वृषस्व
paragraphs.translit: piba rāye śavase hūyamānaḥ piba madhvastṛpadindrā vṛṣasva

paragraphs.text: 2. Drink of the foodful juice stirred into motion, drink what thou choosest of the flowing Soma.
paragraphs.original: अस्य पिब क्षुमतः प्रस्थितस्येन्द्र सोमस्य वरमा सुतस्य ।
paragraphs.translit: asya piba kṣumataḥ prasthitasyendra somasya varamā sutasya |

paragraphs.text: Giver of weal, be joyful in thy spirit, and turn thee hitherward to bless and prosper.
3. Let heavenly Soma gladden thee, O Indra, let that effused among mankind delight thee.
paragraphs.original: ममत्तु त्वा दिव्यः सोम इन्द्र ममत्तु यः सूयते पार्थिवेषु ।
paragraphs.translit: mamattu tvā divyaḥ soma indra mamattu yaḥ sūyate pārthiveṣu |

paragraphs.text: Rejoice in that whereby thou gavest freedom, and that whereby thou conquerest thy foemen.
paragraphs.original: ममत्तु येन वरिवश्चकर्थ ममत्तु येन निरिणासि शत्रून्
paragraphs.translit: mamattu yena varivaścakartha mamattu yena niriṇāsi śatrūn

paragraphs.text: 4. Let Indra come, impetuous, doubly mighty, to the poured juice, the Bull, with two Bay Coursers.
paragraphs.original: आ द्विबर्हा अमिनो यात्विन्द्रो वृषा हरिभ्यां परिषिक्तमन्धः ।
paragraphs.translit: ā dvibarhā amino yātvindro vṛṣā haribhyāṃ pariṣiktamandhaḥ |

paragraphs.text: With juices pressed in milk, with meath presented, glut evermore thy bolt, O Foe-destroyer.
paragraphs.original: गव्या सुतस्य प्रभृतस्य मध्वः सत्रा खेदामरुशहा वृषस्व
paragraphs.translit: gavyā sutasya prabhṛtasya madhvaḥ satrā khedāmaruśahā vṛṣasva

paragraphs.text: 5. Dash down, outflaming their sharp flaming weapons, the strong-holds of the men urged on by demons.
paragraphs.original: नि तिग्मानि भ्राशयन्भ्राश्यान्यव स्थिरा तनुहि यातुजूनाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ni tigmāni bhrāśayanbhrāśyānyava sthirā tanuhi yātujūnām |

paragraphs.text: I give thee, Mighty One, great strength and conquest: go, meet thy foes and rend them in the battle.
paragraphs.original: उग्राय ते सहो बलं ददामि प्रतीत्या शत्रून्विगदेषु वृश्च
paragraphs.translit: ugrāya te saho balaṃ dadāmi pratītyā śatrūnvigadeṣu vṛśca

paragraphs.text: 6. Extend afar the votary's fame and glory, as the firm archer's strength drives off the foeman.
paragraphs.original: व्यर्य इन्द्र तनुहि श्रवांस्योज स्थिरेव धन्वनोऽभिमातीः ।
paragraphs.translit: vyarya indra tanuhi śravāṃsyoja sthireva dhanvano'bhimātīḥ |

paragraphs.text: Ranged on our side, grown strong in might that conquers, never defeated, still increase thy body.
7. To thee have we presented this oblation: accept it, Sovran Ruler, free from anger.
paragraphs.original: इदं हविर्मघवन्तुभ्यं रातं प्रति सम्राळहृणानो गृभाय ।
paragraphs.translit: idaṃ havirmaghavantubhyaṃ rātaṃ prati samrāḷahṛṇāno gṛbhāya |

paragraphs.text: Juice, Maghavan, for thee is pressed and ripened: eat, Indra, drink of that which stirs to meet thee.
paragraphs.original: तुभ्यं सुतो मघवन्तुभ्यं पक्वोऽद्धीन्द्र पिब च प्रस्थितस्य
paragraphs.translit: tubhyaṃ suto maghavantubhyaṃ pakvo'ddhīndra piba ca prasthitasya

paragraphs.text: 8. Eat, Indra, these oblations which approach thee: be pleased with food made ready and with Soma.
paragraphs.original: अद्धीदिन्द्र प्रस्थितेमा हवींषि चनो दधिष्व पचतोत सोमम् ।
paragraphs.translit: addhīdindra prasthitemā havīṃṣi cano dadhiṣva pacatota somam |

paragraphs.text: With entertainment we receive thee friendly: effectual be the sacrificer's wishes.
paragraphs.original: प्रयस्वन्तः प्रति हर्यामसि त्वा सत्याः सन्तु यजमानस्य कामाः
paragraphs.translit: prayasvantaḥ prati haryāmasi tvā satyāḥ santu yajamānasya kāmāḥ

paragraphs.text: 9. I send sweet speech to Indra and to Agni: with hymns I speed it like a boat through waters.
Even thus, the Gods seem moving round about me, the fountains and bestowers of our riches.
paragraphs.original: अया इव परि चरन्ति देवा ये अस्मभ्यं धनदा उद्भिदश्च
paragraphs.translit: ayā iva pari caranti devā ye asmabhyaṃ dhanadā udbhidaśca
